tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /bsgrub pa'i bslab bya'i gzhi gsum gyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus blo gsal 'jug sgo zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /bsgrub pa'i bslab bya'i gzhi gsum gyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus blo gsal 'jug sgo zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bsgrub pa'i bslab bya'i gzhi gsum gyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus blo gsal 'jug sgo zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo shākya mu na ye/ 'dul ba'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho yi/ /brjod bya gzhi gsum rnam gzhag gi /snying po blo ldan gzhan dag la/ /phan phyir go slar bshad par bya/ /'dir 'dul ba'i yig cha nas 'byung ba'i don nye bar mkho ba 'ga' zhig bsdus nas dgod par bya ste/ de yang spyir gzhi de la gsum dang bcu bdun gnyis las dang po ni/ sdom pa ma thob pa thob par byed pa dang thob pa mi nyams par srung bar byed pa dang nyams na phyir bcos pa'i gzhi gsum ste/ 'dul ba'i gzhung don thams cad ni der 'dus so/ /'dir ni bsgrub pa'i bslab bya'i gzhi gsum ste/ bslab pa yongs su sbyong ba dang bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen bsten pa dang las kyi gzhi'o/ /dang po la yang gzhi gsum ste/ gso sbyong dang dbyar gnas dang dgag dbye'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ thun mong gi rnam gzhag dang*/ so so'i rang bzhin no/ /dang po la lnga/ sgra don dang dbye ba dang bsdu ba dang go rim dang phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ bslab pa gso zhing sdig pa sbyong bas na gso sbyong zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na bdun te zhi gnas kyi gso sbyong dang mthun pa dang bcu bzhi pa dang bco lnga pa dang gnod pa bzlog pa dang rtsod pa zhi ba dang bkra shis pa'i gso sbyong ngo*/ /gsum pa/ de dag bsdu na zhi gnas dang mthun pa'i gso sbyong gnyis su 'du ste phyi ma lnga mthun pa'i gso sbyong gi nang du 'du ba'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa la/ gzhi gnas kyi gso sbyong zhes pa ni zhi lhag gnyis so so dang*/ gnyis ka zung 'brel du bsgom pa ci rigs te/ skye rim gyi dbang du byas na mthun pa'i gso skyong la brten nas zhi gnas kyi gso sbyong 'byung yang*/ gzhung du rjod byed nyung ba dang mchog gi dbang du mdzad nas zhi gnas kyi gso sbyong sngon du gsungs so/ /lnga pa ni/ gnas skabs mngon mtho lha mi dang mthar thug myang 'das 'thob par 'gyur ba'o/ /gnyis pa la zhi gnas sgom tshul ni gzhan du shes par bya zhing*/

mthun pa'i gso sbyong 'chad pa la gsum/ gang du bya ba'i gnas/ gang gis byed pa'i gang zag /ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga'o/ /dang po ni/ cho ga'i sgo nas blo mthun byas shing rang grub pa 'am/ skyes bus rtsol bas byas pa gang rung ste chung tshad gding ba bzhi bcu shong ba dang*/ tshe tshad dbus nas phyogs su dpag tshad phyed gsum gsum yod pa'i gnas su bya ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni spyir rab byung sde lnga kas bya dgos la/ bye brag tu mi mthun pa gnyis dang bral ba sogs dang 'dun pa dang yongs dag 'bul ba'i sgo nas rung zhing bos pa'i gang zag gis byed do/ /gsum pa la gsum/ sbyor dngos rjes kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gaṇḍi brdung pa sogs kyis dge 'dun bsdu ba dang*/ ltung ba phyir bcos pa dang*/ chos nyan bshad byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ dus nam gyi tshe bya ba dang*/ cho ga ji ltar bya ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ / spyir lo gcig la gso sbyong nyer bzhi yod de/ bcu bzhi pa drug dang bco lnga pa bco brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ de yang yar ngo'i bcu gnyis po thams cad mar ngo'i nang nas drug ste bco brgyad ni zhag thub pa'i bco lnga pa yin zhing*/ mar ngo'i gzhan drug ni zhag mi thub pa'i bcu bzhi pa yin la/ zla lhag yod pa'i tshe nyer drug kyang 'byung ngo*/ /gnyis pa la lnga/ sgra don dang dus dang zla ba dang 'byung ba'i rgyu dang dogs gcod do/ /dang po ni/ gso sbyong bco lnga pa rnams la zhag thub pa zhes bya ste/ 'jig rten gyi grags pa ltar nyin zhag bco lnga longs pa'i dus su bya dgos pa'i phyir/ bcu bzhi pa la ni zhag mi thub ces bya ste/ tshes zhag gis nyin zhag gi dod ma thub pa'i dbang gis tshes zhag bco lnga pa yin kyang nyin zhag bcu bzhi pa'i dus su bya dgos pa'i phyir/ tshes zhag gis nyin zhag gi dod mi thub ste/ tshes zhag ni nyin zhag las chu tshod gcig ma longs tsam gyis thung ba'i phyir ro/

/gnyis pa ni/ dgun stod dgun smad dpyid stod smad/ dbyar stod smad gnyis re ste/ dus tshigs drug la zla ba gnyis gnyis yod pa'i zla ba phyed dang gnyis 'das shing phyed lus pa'i tshe zhag mi thub de 'byung ba'i phyir/gsum pa ni/ hor zla dang sbyar na go sla bas hor zla dang po gsum pa lnga pa bdun pa dgu pa bcu gcig pa ste drug gi mjug tu zhag mi thub 'byung bas gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa yin la/ gzhan thams cad bco lnga pa ste bcu pa'i bcu drug nas lo 'go bzung shing mar ngo sngon 'gro'i dbang du byas na/ nya skar dang sbyar na rgyal dang dbo dang sa ga dang chu stod khrums dang smin drug zla ba drug gi mar ngo la ni bcu bzhi pa 'byung*/ de drug gi yar ngo dang mgo mchu nag pa basnron gro bzhin tha skar drug gi yar ngo mar ngo gnyis ka la bco lnga 'byung ba'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i mar ngo la gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa byas nas hor zla dang po'i mar ngo'i nyin zhag bcu bzhi pa la zhag mi thub 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nas dang po'i nyer dgu'i bar la nyin zhag drug cu ma rdzogs kyang tshes zhag drug cu rdzogs pa'i phyir te/ de nas de'i bar la nyin zhag nga dgu rdzogs pa gang zhing*/ nyin zhag nga dgu dang tshes zhag drug cu ni cung zad tsam ma gtogs yun mnyam pa'i phyir te/ nyin zhag nga dgu 'das pa'i tshe tshes zhag nga dgu 'das par ma zad chu tshod nga dgu ma longs tsam zhig kyang 'das pa gang zhig /rags rtsis chu tshod nga dgu'i yun tshad la tshes zhag gcig tu 'jog pa'i phyir/ de nas de'i bar la tshes zhag drug cu yod kyang nyin zhag nga dgu las med pas na nyin zhag gcig chad par bzhag ste/ cung zad rgyas par ni bdag gis 'dul ba'i yig cha dang dus tshigs kyi bshad par bris zin pas mi 'chad do/ /lnga pa ni gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa rnams nyin zhag la ltos nas bcu bzhi pa yin la/

tshes zhag la ltos nas ni bco lnga pa ste dus nor nas byas pa la ni nges pa med do/ /gzhan gnod pa bzlog pa'i gso sbyong sogs byed pa'i dus ni nam dgos pa'i tshe yin gyi/ dus nges pa can med do/ /gnyis pa cho ga ji ltar bya ba la sngon du ltung ba byin brlab bya ba gsungs kyang yul chos kyis phyag len du mi byed pa mang la/ gzhan rten rab byung bsnyen par ma rdzogs pas spyi bshags yan byas rjes gso sbyong gi sngags tshig lan gsum brjod dgos la/ bsnyen par rdzogs pas ni so thar gyi mdo 'don pa'i sgo nas gso sbyong byed pa yin te/ de yang da lta gling gzhi tsam 'don pa phyag len du dar yang*/ gzhan pham pa dang lhag ma sogs ky-i gzhung yang 'don mi rung ba min no/ /gsum pa ni/ rjes su bsngo ba dang smon lam ji skad 'byung ba bzhin bya'o/ /de dag ni spyir btang ste/ dmigs bsal la yongs su dag pa dang*/ byin gy-is brlabs pa dang*/ mdor bsdus pa dang*/ dgag dbye'i gso sbyong dang bzhi yod pa'i dang po ni/ glo bur pa dang nad pa sogs kyis dge 'dun la yongs dag phul ba dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ gso sbyong byed pa po grangs ma tshang na byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags tshig lan gsum brjod pa dang*/ gsum pa ni/ rang gcig bu lta bus gso sbyong gi dus su sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*/ zhes sogs kyi tshig bcad gnyis tsam brjod pa dang*/ bzhi pa ni dgag dbye byas pas kyang gso sbyong byas pa'i go chod pa'o/ /gnyis pa dbyar gnas la drug /dgos pa dang gang zag dang gnas dang dus dang cho ga dang dam tshig go /dang po ni/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi yon tan 'phel ba dang*/ gzhan la mi gnod pa dang*/ gnas zhig ral bcos pa dang*/ bya ba mang ba spang ba sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rab byung sde lnga kas kyang rung ste/ dmigs bsal mi rung ba ni yod do/ /gsum pa ni/ mtshan ma brtan po dang ldan pa'i gnas sngar bshad pa'i tshe tshad du byas pa de lta bu yid dang mthun zhing mthun rkyen 'dzom por khas len pa ni gtsug lag khang lta bur bya ba'i thog dang mtha' skor dang sgo med pa'i thang sogs su byar mi rung ngo*/

/zhes pa la/ dus tshigs dang bstun dgos pas de la bzhi dang lnga gnyis las/ dbyar snga ma ni dbyar zla 'bring po'i nya'i phyi nyin te/ 'jig rten yongs grags la drug pa'i bcu drug yin la/ de dbyar zla tha chung gi mar ngo'i tshes gcig tu byas te de nas ston zla 'bring po'i tshes bco lnga'i bar zla ba gsum khas len dgos shing*/ don la dgu pa'i bco lnga'i bar ro/ /dbyar phyi ma ni dbyar zla tha chung gi nya'i phyi nyin te/ yongs grags la bdun pa'i bcu drug yin la/ de ston zla ra ba'i mar ngo'i tshes gcig dang*/ de nas ston zla tha chung gi bco lnga'i bar zla ba gsum du khas len pa'o/ /de ni don la bcu pa'i bco lnga'i bar te zla ba tshang ma gsum re yin yang da lta zla phyed dang gnyis re tsam zhig khas len pa ni dus kyis dbang ste/ sbyin bdag byed mkhan dkon pa'i dbang la sogs pas yin no/ /'on kyang khas len pa'i tshe zla ba gsum du khas len dgos so/ /dus tshigs la lngar phye ba'i tshe/ dgun dpyid kyi zla ba bzhi bzhi rdzogs pa'i rjes kyi dbyar tsam gyi zla ba gro bzhin zla ba'i mar ngo'i tshes gcig nas dbyug pa zla ba'i bco lnga'i bar dbyar snga ma dang*/ khrums zla'i mar ngo'i tshes gcig ni dbyar thung ngu'i nyin zhag gcig ste de nas smin drug gi bco lnga'i bar dbyar gyi phyi ma khas len pa'i dus so/ /dus tshigs la bzhir byed pa'i tshe mgo rgyal mchu dbo nag pa sa ga snon chu stod gro bzhin khrums tha skar smin drug ste nya skar bcu gnyis po gsum tshan du phye ba yin la/ sngar 'byed pa'i tshe dgun dpyid gnyis la zla ba bzhi bzhi dang*/ de nas gro bzhin zla ba ni dbyar tsam/ khrums zla'i tshes gcig ni dbyar thung ngu*/ de nas nyin zhag gcig chad pa'i khrum sogs zla ba gsum ni dbyar ring po ste/ de rnams ni mar ngo'i sngon 'gro'i dbang du byas shing*/ bcu ba'i bcu drug nas dgun gyi thog ma dang lo 'go 'dzin pa'i lugs so/

/lnga pa cho ga la gnyis/ sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi'o/ /dang po ni dbyar khas len pa la zhag bcu dang bco lnga skor yod pa'am de dag las chung pa'ang rung ste gang du khas len pa'i gnas byi dor sogs byas nas gnas dang mal stan sogs sta gon bya/ gnas mal stong pa sogs kyi ched du khyad chos dgu 'am bcu ldan gyi dge slong gsol gnyis kyi las kyis bsko/ khyad chos bcu ni bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa rnam dag sogs bcu ste gzhan du lta'o/ /de nas bskos pa'i dge slong des tshul shing sta gon byas te gnas 'dir dge 'dun gyi nang du 'khrugs long mi byed cing thos bsam bsgom pa'i bya ba 'di dang 'di bya'o zhes sogs khrims kyi bya ba gnas skabs su babs pa brjod/ des tshul shing 'brim pa'i sngon du dge 'dun la gsol ba 'ba' zhig pa'i las byed cing tshul bzhin 'bring pa sogs bya'o/ /de nas gnas dang mal stob pa'i tshe/ rgya gar ltar na gnas khang dang ljon shing sogs kyi drung dang ne'u sing la sogs pa rgan rim bzhin du stob par bya zhing*/ de bzhin du khri'u dang stan dang gos la sogs pa'i mal cha rnams kyang ster bar bya dgos na'ang 'dir yul chos kyis de ltar byed pa mi 'ong bas phyogs 'dra tsam ston cing de la longs spyod tshul brjod par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ spyir btang dang dmigs bsal lo/ / dang po ni/ dge slong gi mdun du btsun pa 'am tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba mtshams kyi nang dang bcas pa'i gnas 'dir 'di lta ste gnas ral pa dang 'grum pa bcos pa'i slad du dbyar snga ma zla ba gsum du gnas par khas blang ngo*/ /bdag dbyar 'di na mchis shing bdag gi dbyar gyi gnas ni 'di lags so/ /zhes lan gsum dang thabs legs bya/ dbyar gyi ma yin na de'i ming nas brjod de khas blang bar bya'o/ /gnas ral pa dang grum pa bcos pa'i slad du zhes 'byung ba ltar na/

dbyar nang du gtsug lag khang lta bu zhig ral du song ba phran bu bcos su rung ste/ gnas ral pa dang grum pa ni zhig ral du song ba'i don yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dbyar khas len gyi cho ga ma grub kyang gnas 'dir dbyar zla ba gsum gnas par bya'o snyam du dam bcas pas dbyar khas blang pa'i go chod par bshad de de la'ang rnam phyogs su 'gro ba'i tshe byin brlab bya'o/ /drug pa dam tshig la/ bskos pa'i dge slong des zla ba phyed phyed nas dge 'dun phyi nang nas gnas mal sogs la longs ji ltar spyad brtags te log par spyad na bcos su gzhug cing klog pa thos bsam dang spong ba bsam gtan la brtson pa sogs dge phyogs ma gtogs bya ba mi mang ba dang*/ rnyed pa mi bgo zhing 'khrugs long byed pa sogs spong ba'o/ /dbyar gyi dus su dbyar byin gyis ma brlabs par mtshams kyi phyi rol du zhag gcig kyang gnas par mi rung ste dbyar ral zhes pa'i nyes pa 'byung bas so/ /chos ldan gyi dgos pa la zhag gcig nas bdun gyi bar gang rung byin gyis brlabs nas mtshams las 'dar rung ngo*/ /'gro ba'i tshe dge slong zhig gi drung du thugs gtad zhus nas tsog pur 'dug ste/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas mtshams kyi nang dang bcas pa'i gnas 'dir dbyar snga ma zla ba gsum gnas par khas blang pa las/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba bgyi ba zhig gi slad du dgung bdun mtshams kyi slad rol du mchi ba dang*/ de tshun chad kyis slar mchi bar byin gyis brlab po/ /zhes lan gsum brjod cing thabs legs bya/ mtshams kyi phyi rol tu zhag gcig nas drug ma 'das kyi bar du sdod pas ni/ zhag gcig gam gnyis sogs gang brjod dgos pa de brjod nas byin gyis brlab bo/ /zhag de la phyir 'ongs na zhag gcig dang zhag gcig sdod pas ni zhag gnyis kyi byin brlab bya ba sogs 'dra'o/ /zhag bdun byin gyis brlabs pas ni zhag bdun gyi mtshan mo 'dar mi rung te/

gzhan la'ang 'dra'o/ /brdzun byas te byin gyis brlabs kyang mi 'chags so/ /chos ldan gyi bya ba khyad par can gyi ched du zhag brgyad nas bzhi bcu'i bar mtshams kyi phyi rol du sdod pa'i gnang ba thob na sdod rung yang*/ dgag dbye byed pa la zhag drug las med na ni byin brlabs mi 'chags te/ mdo rtsar mtha'i zhag drug la byin gyis brlabs pa mi 'chags so zhes gsung*/ mkhas pa kha cig de ni mtha'i zhag drug la zhag bdun gyi byin brlabs mi 'chags pa'i don yin gyi/ byin rlabs gtan mi 'chags pa min no zhes bshad pa'ang snang ste 'thad par sems kyang brtags par bya ba'i gnas so/ /gsum pa dgag dbye la lnga/ gang zag dang dus dang dngos po dang cho ga dang dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir dbyar khas blangs pa rnams kyis dgag dbye byed dgos la/ dmigs bsal glo bur du lhag pa'i dge slong gis kyang dgag dbye byar rung ste/ dgag dbye ni gso sbyong gi dod yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la dus dang dus min gyi dgag dbye gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dbyar snga ma yin na hor zla dgu pa dbyug pa zla ba'i bco lnga dang*/ phyi ma yin na bcu pa smin drug zla ba'i bco lnga ni dgag dbye byed pa'i dus so/ /dus min ni/ dbyar zla ba gsum gnas pa'i mthun rkyen ma tshang ba slogs pa'i dbang gis zla ba gcig gam phyed dang gnyis 'das pa'i nya stong gang rung dang bstun nas dgag dbye byar rung ste gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /da lta zla ba phyed dang gnyis gnas te dgag dbye byed pa ni spyir dus min ltar snang yang*/ dus kyi dgag dbye bzhag tu rung bar mngon no/ /gsum pa dngos po la spyi btang dang dmigs bsal gnyis las dang po ni/ dgag dbye'i nyin dbyar gnas pa rnams kyis kyang mthong thos dogs gsum gyi sgo nas ltung ba gleng ba'i skabs phye ste/ ltung ba gleng ba na ltung ba de'i ngo bo gang yin brtags pa dang*/

ltung ba yod na bshags bsdams byed dgos la/ dmigs bsal dgos pa'i dbang gi ltung ba de mi gleng bar re zhig 'jog dgos pa'ang yod do/ /bzhi pa cho ga la gsum sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi dang go rim mo/ /dang po ni/ dgag dbye byed pa la nye ba'i tshe dgag dbye 'byung ba'i dus gzhan la brjod pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang sogs byi dor dang bcu bzhi'i dus sam nyer dgu lta bu la chos nyan bshad byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa la ltung ba dang rdzas kyi dgag dbye gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'dir gzhung las bco lnga'i dus su sngon du las byed pa po chos bsgrags kyi mdo 'don pa yan chad gso sbyong gi skabs bzhin byas pa'i rjes su spyi bshags bya bar bshad pas tshul khrims yang dag par ldan pa'i mdo yang bzhag chog par mngon te/ gang ltar yang bco lnga lta bu'i snga dro'i tshe mthong thos dogs gsum gyi sgo nas glengs pa'i ltung ba yod pa rnams la bshags bsdams byed cing*/ de nas gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las kyis dgag dbye go bar byed pa'i dge slong bsko bar bya'o/ /de nas bskos pa'i dge slong des dge 'dun la gsol ba 'ba' zhig pa'i las byed/ de nas gral rim bzhin du rtswa 'grim de'i rjes su dge slong re re'i mdun du 'dug ste rtswa de phan tshun bsnol ba'i tshul gyis bzung nas/ thugs gtad dang dgongs gsol byas te/ deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa'am bcu bzhi pa lags te/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i yang dgag dbye bco lnga pa 'am bcu bzhi pa lags na/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bdag la mthong ba dang thos pa dang dogs pa'i gnas gsum gyis dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun rnams la dgag dbye bgyid kyis/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis bdag la rjes su gdams su gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis bdag la rjes su bstan du gsol/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis bdag la rjes su gzung du gsol/

thugs brtse ba can tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag la thugs brtse bar mdzad du gsol/ ltung ba shes shing mthong na chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin slad bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum dang thabs legs bya/ nad pa lta bu me nus pas lan gnyis sam gcig gis kyang rung la/ bskos pas ni gzhan gyi mdun du bya'o/ /gzhung du dgag dbye bco lnga par gsungs pa ni zla ba gsum gyi dbang du byas pa yin la/ da lta phyogs 'dir ni dbyar zla ba phyed dang gnyis tsam gnas pa'i tshe khrums zla'i mar ngo hor zla bdun pa'i nyer dgu lta bu'i dgag dbye byed dgos shing de'i tshe gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa 'byung bas dgag dbye yang bcu bzhi bar mngon te/ kha cig dbye ba med par bco lnga par byed de brtag /de nas rtswa rnams bsdus te gnas 'dir dge slong 'di snyed cig gis dgag dbye mdzad do zhes brjod cing gzhan rnams kyis legs par mdzad do zhes sogs sbyin no/ /gnyis pa rdzas kyi dgag dbye ni/ bskos pa'i dge slong gis rdzas khab yan chad gang rung lag tu bzung nas rgan rim gyi mdun du 'dug la/ btsun pa lngas 'di lta bus dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyi rung ngam/ zhes dris nas gzhan gyis legs par rung ngo zhes sogs brjod do/ /gsum pa go rim ni dang por dge slong rnams dang de nas dge tshul gyis bya ba yin la/ dbyar gyi nang du dge tshul slong rnams kyis rnyed pa'i yo byad bsdus te thams cad lhan cig tu bgo bar bya dgos kyang 'dir yul chos kyis mi byed do/ /lnga pa dgos pa la/ ltung ba'i dgag dbye ni tshul khrims dang chos rnam par dag pa'i ched yin la/ rdzas kyi dgag dbye de rnyed po'i sgo dbye ba'i ched do/ /'o na da lta ltung ba'i ngo bo gtan la 'bebs pa sogs rdzogs par mi byed pa ci zhe na skyon med de/ yul chos kyi dbang gis mi bde bar dgongs nas ltung ba gang yin 'dri ba sogs ma byas te de 'dra mang ngo*/

/dgag dbye'i don ni dbyar nang du ltung ba byung yang gleng ba bzhag cing*/ rnyed pa byung ba rnams kyang bgo ba bkag nas dbyar gnas rdzogs pa'i tshe ltung ba gleng ba dang rnyed pa bgo ba'i skabs dbye ba'i don no/ /dgag dbye'i dus kyi dmigs bsal ni sngar bshad zin pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen bsten pa la gsum/ gos dang sman dang gnas mal mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba'o/ /dang po la/ dbyar khas blangs nas sra brkyang zla ba lnga 'ding bar bshad kyang phyag len du ma dar bas bshad pa 'dir gzhag /'on kyang sra brkyang bting ba'i dgos pa ni smin drug nas dbo zla'i bar zla ba lnga bting ba'i ring la rang rang gi chos gos rnam pa gsum gyi byin rlabs dbyung nas sra brkyang du chos gos rnam pa gsum thun mong du byin gyis brlabs pa nas/ de'i tshe 'chang 'bral 'jog gsum la sogs pa du ma yang byar rung ste/ bag yangs dang 'brel ba'o/ /spyir gos ni log 'tshol char gtogs dang bcas spangs nas yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba la brten nas bsgrub par bya zhing*/ rgyu dang bzo tshul ni gzhung tsha ba nas gsal ba ltar yin la/ 'on kyang da lta chos gos rnam pa gsum gyi glegs bu rnams ni kha steng 'og tu lta tshul mi 'dra ba byed pa 'di la kha cig de ni mi 'thad de/ tshul de mdo rtsar kha phyogs phyogs su lta bar bshad pa'i don legs par ma go ba'i rkyen yin pa'i phyir ro/ /mdo rtsa'i don ni sum phran gcig dbus dang gzhan rnams g.yas g.yon du kha lta ba'i don yin gyi/ glegs bu rnams ni kha lta phyogs mi 'dra bar byed pa'i don ma yin pa'i phyir/ glegs bu rnams kha yar man du lta ba 'di ltar byas na bya spu non gyi tshul du mi 'byung ngo zhes gsung pa ltar 'thad ngam snyam ste/ slob dpon tshul khrims bsrungs kyis mdzad pa'i phran tshegs 'grel bar/ tshul bus snes non par ma gyur pa'i phyogs ni glegs bu yin te glegs bu dang glegs bu phyed pa glegs bu phyed pa dang mnyam par bya'o/

/zhes gsal bar bshad cing*/ gzhan las kyang glegs bus glegs bu phyed pa bya spu non pa'i tshul du'ang bya bar bshad pas/ glegs bu yug dang yug mnyam zhing phyed dang phyed mnyam par byas nas 'dug par rigs so/ /glegs bu rnams kha yar man du bstan pa 'di ltar byas nas gyon pa'i tshe bya spu non gyi tshul du 'ong ba'ang shin tu dka'o/ /des na glegs bu yug rnams stod dang phyed pa smad du 'ong ba lung dang rigs pas kyang 'thad pa ltar mthong ngo*/ /der ma zad rje'i rnam sbyar da lta bzhugs pa zhig la'ang de bzhin snang zhes gsung pas/ 'dir dogs slong tsam byas pa ste gzhan mang po dang ma mthun na klan ka 'ong bar snang bar brtags par bya'o/ /'tsho ba'i yo byed bcu gsum ste/ snam sbyar dang bla gos dang mthang gos dang*/ sham thabs dang sham thabs kyi gzan dang*/ rdul gzan dang rdul gzan gyi gzan dang*/ gdong phyis dang rnag gzan dang g.yan pa dgab pa dang*/ skra gzed dang*/ gding ba dang*/ dbyar gyi gos ras chen no/ /rnam sbyar zhes pa ni snam phran rnams dras te sbyar nas drub pa'i don dang*/ bla gos kyi bla ni/ steng ste steng gos sam stod gos dang*/ mthang gos kyi thang ni nang steng nang gos sam smad gos kyi don no/ /snam sbyar la rab 'bring tha ma gsum ste de re re la'ang nang tshan gyis phye na gsum gsum ste dgu yod la/ de yang rab kyi rab ni snam phran nyer lnga ma/ 'bring nyer gsum ma/ tha ma nyer gcig ma'o/ /'bring gi rab ni snam phran bcu dgu ma/ 'bring bcu bdun ma/ tha ma bco lnga ma'o/ /tha ma'i rab ni snam phran bcu gsum ma/ 'bring ni bcu gcig ma/ tha ma ni dgu ma'o/ /snam sbyar rab skor gsum gyi snam phran re re la'ang glegs bu phyed dang lnga lnga 'ong*/ 'bring skor gsum gyi snam phran re re la glegs bu phyed dang bzhi re dang*/ tha ma skor gsum gyi snam phra re la glegs bu phyed dang gsum re'o/

/bla gos ni snam phran bdun ma ste/ snam phran re re la glegs bu phyed dang gsum re'o/ /mthang gos ni snam phran lnga dang glegs bu phyed gnyis/ gding ba la glegs bu phyed gnyis so/ /snam sbyar la dras drubs dgos shing*/ bla gos dang mthang gos la rab dras drubs dang*/ 'bring lhan thabs/ tha ma thang thang bor yang rung bar bshad do/ /chos gos rnam gsum dras drubs ma'i che tshad ni/ srid bu khru lnga dang zheng du khru gsum yin la/ tha tshad srid du khru phyed lnga dang zheng du khru phyed gsum ste/ de'i bar ni 'bring tshad do/ /ma dras pa'i bla gos che tshad ni srid du khru bcu gnyis dang zheng du khru gsum/ chung tshad ni srid du khru phyed lnga'am drug bdun dang zheng khru phyed dang gsum ste/ de'i bar 'bring tshad du byas kyang rung ngo*/ /sham thabs che tshad ni srid du khru bdun dang zheng du khru do'o/ /chung tshad ni rgyab nas pus mo gnyis dang lte ba'i dkyil 'khor khebs pa tsam mo/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe snam sbyar dngos yin na thugs gtad dang dgongs gsol byas te bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i chos gos bgyis lags pa rung ba spyad par 'os pa 'di chos gos snam sbyar tu byin gyis brlab bo/ /zhes lan gsum du thabs legs bya/ de bzhin du bla gos dang mthang gos dang shams thabs dang de'i gzan nas ras chen gyi bar bcu gnyis po thams cad la'ang snam sbyar zhes pa'i ming brje ba ma gtogs cho ga sngar ltar bya'o/ /chos gos rnam gsum rgyur dmigs shing rung ba yin na/ gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar byin brlabs bya la/ rgyur mi rung ba'i dod tsam yin na/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gos 'di snam sbyar du byin gyis brlab po zhes dang*/ de bzhin du gzhan gnyis la'ang sbyor/ sham thabs ni nyin mo mthang gos kyi 'og tu gyon pa dang*/ sham thabs kyi gzan ni mtshan mo mthang gos kyi 'og tu gyon pa ste tshad ni mthang gos bzhin no/

/rdul gzan dang de'i gzan ni sngar ltar nyin mo dang mtshan mo bla gos kyi 'og tu gyaun pa ste tshad ni bla gos bzhin no/ /gding ba ni srid du khru gsum dang zheng du khru do dang sor drug go /lhag ma rnams ni 'dir mi 'chad de gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar ro/ /gzhan yang chos gos rnam gsum dang gding ba la sogs pa lhag pa yod na de rnams lhag pa'i yo byad du byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ lhag ma mang ba'i yo byad du byin gyis brlab dgos so/ /der ma zad snam sbyar lta bu mang po yod na gcig 'tsho ba'i yo byad dang gcig lhag pa'i yo byad dang gzhan rnams mkho ba'i yo byad du byin gyis brlab rung bar bshad do/ /'dul ba nas 'byung ba ltar byed dgos pa rnams la yul chos kyi ma nus na/ yo byad lhag po thams cad bla ma dang dkon mchog la bsngos nas de la yid gtad de bcang bar byas na phan yon thob cing nyes pa gtan med pa'am nyes pa chung bar gyur ba'i dgos pa yod par bshad pas de ltar du bya la/ de min sred pa dang bcas te bdag tu bzung na nyes pa ma gtogs gzhan mi 'byung ngo*/ /gos kyi skor sogs yo byad 'chang tshul rnams tshul bzhin byas pa'i phan yon dang ma byas pa'i nyes dmigs ni gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar shes par bya'o/ /sman la bzhi ste/ dus rung dang thun tshod dang zhag bdun pa dang ji srid 'tshong bcang gi sman no/ /dang po ni gtso bor bkres nad sel bar byed cing dge slong gis snga dro kho nar longs spyod du rung ba ste/ de la dbye na bza' ba lnga dang bca' ba lnga'o/ /dang po ni/ 'bras chan dang zan dang sha dang phye dang khur ba lnga'o/ /gnyis pa ni rtsa ba dang sdong bu dang me tog dang 'bras bu dang 'dab ma lnga'o/ /der ma zad thug pa dang zho dang 'o ma dang dar ba la sogs pa'o/ /rtsa ba zhes pa ni la phug dang a rdog dang gro ma la sogs pa dang*/ sdong bu ni bur shing lcam 'big dang la phig tu grags pa sogs dang*/

me tog ni padma dang utpal sogs dang*/ 'bras bu ni rgun 'brum kham bu star kha ku shu sogs dang*/ lo ma ni a rdog dang la phug gi lo ma lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa thun tshod du rung ba'i sman ni gtso bo skom nad sel zhing dge slong gis gling 'dir skya reng shar nas nyi ma nub pa'i thun tshod tshun chad du longs spyod du rung ba ste/ tshags kyis btsags pa'i tsam thar shin tu sla ba dang*/ bu ram gyi khu ba shin tu sla ba lta bu'o/ /gsum pa zhag bdun pa'i sman ni gtso bor 'dus pa'i nad sel zhing dge slong gis zhag bdun gyi mtha' tshun chad du byin gyis brlabs nas longs spyad du rung ba ste/ zhun mar dang 'bru mar dang sbrang dang bu ram la sogs pa rnams so/ /bzhi pa 'tsho 'chang gi sman ni/ rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'i nad ci rigs sel zhing dge slong gis ji srid 'tsho'i bar du byin gyis brlabs nas longs spyad du rung ba ste/ a bar skyur gsum sogs gso spyad kyi gzhung nas bshad pa'i sman yongs grangs phal cher ro/ /'aun kyang gzhung de nas bshad pa'i sman yin na/ dge slong gis bza' rung bas ma khyab ste/ de nas bshad pa'i sman la rnam pa sna tshogs pa 'byung zhing bzar mi rung ba du ma snang ba'i phyir ro nad pa la ni dus rung kyang dus min du longs spyad du rung bar gnang zhing*/ nad pa min yang phongs pa'i dus sogs 'ga' zhig la'ang de ltar du rung ngo*/ /'on kyang chang ni nad pa la'ang gnang ba med do/ /sman de dag byin gyis brlabs tshul ni gzhan nas shes par bya la/ 'dir byin len gyi dbye ba cung zad brjod na/ spyir dge slong gi kha bshal ba'i chu yin na ma gtogs/ skom pas btung ba'i chu la'ang byin len bya dgos par bshad pas bza' btung thams cad la byin len sngon du 'gro dgos so/ /de yang bsnyen par ma rdzogs pas rdzogs pa la byin len stob dgos la/ dmigs bsal bslab byin dge slong gis dge slong rnam dag la byin len 'chags/

de bzhin du dge slong mas dge slong pha dang*/ bslab byin min yang rnam dag min pas rnam dag dang*/ lta ba dman pas lta ba mtho ba la byin le 'chags/ dang po dge slong min pas dge slong la byin len stob ste des dge slong gzhan la'ang byin len 'chags so/ /stob pa po dang len pa po'i bar du mtshams gzhan gyis mchod pa ste/ zheng dang dpang gnyis sor bzhi longs pa'i sa rdo dang shing dang srog chags sogs dang chu dang me yang cung zad tsam gyis mi chog gi /dngos gsal can dgos so/ /byin len nod pa'i gzhi yin na cog tse'i steng du'ang 'chags la byin len lag pa gnyis kas byed dgos kyang mi bde na lag gcig dang*/ spyi thag nye dgos kyang*/ dmigs bsal rigs ngan lta bu las len na/ lag pas mi len par them pa'am rgyug ris 'di'i steng du zhog ces smras nas bzhag kyang byin len gyi go chod par bshad cing*/ grogs med na dus dran byas pas byin len byas pa dang 'dra bar bza' btung rung ngo*/ /byin len 'jig pa'i rgyu ni/ lung bar sdom las/ 'phrog dang 'dri la reg pa dang*/ bsngos dang dge slong min gyur dang*/ /dngos po 'gyur dang skye ba 'gyur/ /dor bas kyang ni byin len 'jig /ces pa dang*/ me chu sogs kyis ma rung bar byas pas kyang byin len 'jig go /byin len byas pa'i bza' btung de la dge slong min pas lag pas dngos su reg na byin len 'jig par 'gyur gyi/ cog tse lta bu bsgul ba tsam gyis byin len mi 'jig ste/ 'jig na khang pa 'gul bas kyang byin len 'jig par gyur na de ni bsgrub mi nus so/ /'on kyang da lta kha cig khyi chung dang a lir grags pa lta bus reg cing bskul ba la mi 'dzem pas snang yang mi 'thad par go'o/ /byin len byas pa'i sman bzhi po spyir byin len ma bshigs pa rang rang gi dus kyi mtha' 'das na gsog 'jog tu 'gyur zhing*/ 'on kyang thun tshod du rung ba lta bu snga dro ba'i ched tsam du byin len byas pa yin na gung yol na'ang gsog 'jog tu 'gyur

ro/ /dgongs gcod rab byung rnams kyis sman phy-i ma gsum la phyi dro longs spyod na chung chu 'debs dgos shing*/ de yang spyir bsnyen rdzogs min pas 'debs la dmigs bsal bsnyen rdzogs pas kyang rung par bshad do/ /sman phyi ma gsum byin gyis brlabs ma brlabs kyi dbang gis ltung ba bskyed tshul mang yang ma bris so/ /gsum pa las kyi gzhi la rgyas par bshad na mang yang*/ grangs tsam bstan pa ni dge slong gi bya ba'i las des brgya rtsa gcig yod de/ gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las nye
